potato_early_blight.symptoms: Dark brown concentric ring spots on mature leaves, yellowing of surrounding leaf tissue, defoliation starting from base.

organic_measures.name: Copper Oxychloride / Bio-agent Spray
organic_measures.method: Spray copper oxychloride (2.5 g/L) or Trichoderma viride formulation (5 g/L).

prevention_measures: Rotate potato fields with non-solanaceous crops for 3 years.
Ensure adequate nitrogen and potassium soil fertilization.
sources: ICAR - Central Potato Research Institute (CPRI) Advisory

potato_late_blight.symptoms: Rapidly expanding water-soaked purplish-black leaf lesions with white fungal downy growth on undersides in cool wet weather.

organic_measures.name: Prophylactic Copper Hydroxide
organic_measures.method: Spray copper hydroxide (2 g/L) as a preventive measure when high humidity and cool temperatures persist.
organic_measures.frequency: Every 5 to 7 days in risk weather

chemical_measures.name: Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Apply immediately at first sign of disease. Observe 14-day PHI.

prevention_measures: Perform proper earthing up to protect tubers from fungal spores.
Kill vines (haulm destruction) 10-14 days before harvest.
sources: UC Davis Potato Late Blight Protocol

potato_healthy.symptoms: Lush green compound leaves, firm stems, free of necrotic spots or rolling.

organic_measures.name: Neem Cake & Bio-fertilizers
organic_measures.method: Apply Neem cake (250 kg/ha) and Azotobacter to soil at planting.

prevention_measures: Maintain hill height during earthing up.
